comparison_requirements: 主体、实际期间和报告边界由来源明确支持；未知口径不能默认为相同。
证据支持原值/陈述及必要维度；单位转换不能消除方法或边界差异。
exclusions: 适用 IED/BREF 时可披露的附加信息。
标题、目录、空白、未披露状态不能作为带值事实；显式零与缺失分开。

raw_values: Disclosure of list of any compliance schedules or derogations granted by competent authorities according to Article 15(4) IED that are associated with implementation of BAT-AELs
source_headers:
Appendix B - ESRS 2 
(SFDR + PILLAR 3 + Benchmark + CL)

Appendix C - ESRS 1
DPs subject to phasing-in provisions applicable to undertaking with less than 750 employees

Appendix C - ESRS 1
DPs subject to phasing-in provisions applicable to all undertakings

reporting_requirement: 每个计划或豁免单独成行并记录主管机关和期限。
